photos.shows: Side facade: stepped tiers with slanted white concrete struts, dark maroon-brown horizontal bands, ribbon windows, green/red LED running sign along upper band, scaffold netting on upper floors, ground-level arcade under cantilever, pine trees, subway exit kiosk

Front (yard) side: wide white horizontal facade, roof sign '서울고속버스터미날' blue letters with red AO logo + 'SEOUL EXPRESS BUS TERMINAL', blue banner text band (3층 꽃상가 / 2·4층 혼수·커튼·홈패션 / 6.7.8층 의류 도매상가), LED screen on roof, flat-roof boarding canopy at right edge, red Kumho bus on wet asphalt yard, Marriott tower behind

Central stair-stepped pyramid with brown-terracotta triangular wall, white central tower with vertical blue sign '서울고속버스터미널' (written 미널) and red AO logo, '의류도매상가 678층', tier signs '생화·조화 꽃 도매상가 3F', '혼수·커튼·홈패션 2·4F', ribbon windows on white terraces, police box with glass facade in front
Plaza in front: low shop arcade with blue band sign '귀금속 도매상가', shopfronts lit, motorbikes, main facade with roof sign, LED screens on roof, Marriott tower behind

Gyeongbu line boarding-gate hall: speckled grey terrazzo/granite floor with yellow tactile strip, white square columns with black skirting, acoustic-tile ceiling with square LED panels, cyan backlit gate signs with white gate numbers + destination (부산 마산 진주 창원 울산 대구 포항), black LED departure board, glass double doors to bays, red LED clock, advertising lightboxes, bench seating at left

Likely a low annex/service block seen from a surface car lot (title ambiguous): 3-4 floor beige panel cladding, grid of bands of windows, green glass curtain section to right with canopy curve, snowy surface parking full of sedans with parking barrier gate
Building reads as stepped pyramid: cream/white tower with vertical blue sign and red logo, brown terracotta tier slabs, ribbon windows between tiers, grey metal box on roof
Long diagonal facade: sloped cream wall panels with regular small square windows between slanted buttresses, brown projecting tier bands, blue sign band text along the slope, parked cars at base

CAUTION: Honam-line (Central City) side, not Gyeongbu. Concourse with white tubular steel truss roof, white marble-clad square columns, polished marble floor, bench, unmanned ticket kiosk sign. Use only as reference for the sister wing

CAUTION: Honam/Central City wing (file titled 하차장 but shows numbered gates). Red-panel gate kiosks each with large white number 5 4 3 2, backlit ad panel on top, marble-clad columns, glass door entry, recessed downlights, green exit sign. Gyeongbu hall likely similar style (see 05)

exterior.overall: Stepped pyramid/ziggurat-like mass: wide low base, tiers narrowing upward to a central white tower (photos 03, 07). Sloped facade on long side with slanted white concrete buttresses (01, 08).
exterior.materials: White/cream painted concrete or panel walls, brown/maroon (terracotta-like) projecting tier slabs and bands, ribbon windows with dark frames (01, 03, 07). Brown wall triangle in front tower (03).
exterior.floors: Sign text states 3F 꽃 도매상가, 2F and 4F 혼수·커튼·홈패션, 6-8F 의류도매상가, B1 한가람문고 (02, 03, 08). Building ~8 floors plus roof box.
exterior.signage: Roof sign '서울고속버스터미날' in blue letters with 'SEOUL EXPRESS BUS TERMINAL' below and red AO logo at left (02); vertical blue sign '서울고속버스터미널' on white tower with red logo at top (03, 07); long blue text bands along tiers listing floors (02, 08); LED running sign green/red (01); big LED screens on roof (02, 04).
exterior.window_rhythm: Ribbon windows per tier; sloped facade has small square windows between each buttress at about 3m spacing (08).
exterior.canopies: Flat steel/glass boarding canopy at yard edge with slight slope (02, right side); cantilever arcade under building at ground level (01).
exterior.roof: Flat roof tiers, grey metal box on top, LED screens (02, 03, 07).

parking.bus_yard: Open wet-asphalt yard in front with coaches parked (Kumho Buslines red/white, gold coach) under long canopy (02).
parking.surface_car_park: Surface lot of mixed sedans with yellow/black barrier gates and small booth on side annex (06).

interior.gate_hall_gyeongbu: Terrazzo/granite speckled grey floor, white columns with black skirting, flat tile ceiling with square LED panels, cyan backlit gate number+destination boards, black LED departure board, glass double doors to bays, yellow tactile strips, wooden benches (05).
interior.honam_wing_reference: Marble columns and floor, tubular white truss roof (09), red-panel gate kiosks with big white numbers (10). Not confirmed for Gyeongbu hall.
interior.flower_market_3F: Only exterior signage seen (03, 08); no interior photo obtained.

not_airport: Facade is brown/cream stepped tiers with painted text bands, not glass-and-steel curtain wall (03, 07)
Large Korean text banners and LED signs for wholesale markets cover the facade (02, 08)
Buses park on open yard under canopies at ground level; no jet bridges (02)

Multiple wholesale shop floors (flowers, clothing, bedding) stacked above the terminal
